description: This PHP class 'AllowedPackages' manages and determines which Composer packages are permitted to scaffold files within a Drupal project, including recursive dependency checks and handling of package options.

classes.name: AllowedPackages
classes.description: Manages allowed packages for scaffolding in a Drupal project, including recursive dependency resolution and event handling.

methods.name: getAllowedPackages
methods.description: Returns a list of all packages permitted to copy scaffold files, including implicit and explicitly allowed packages.

methods.name: event
methods.description: Handles package events to track newly added packages with scaffold options.

methods.name: getTopLevelAllowedPackages
methods.description: Retrieves the list of top-level allowed package names, including implicit ones.

methods.name: recursiveGetAllowedPackages
methods.description: Recursively builds a map of allowed packages based on package options.

methods.name: evaluateNewPackages
methods.description: Checks newly added packages to determine if they are allowed and outputs warnings if not.

methods.name: getPackage
methods.description: Fetches a package object from the current Composer installation by name.
